reviews.text: The staff of this company are always professional and complete assigned tasks with desired results. They are friendly and Management (Byran) is outstanding in every regard. He knows all about pools and is willing to make your pool a wonderful experience all summer long. I highly recommend this service to anyone wanting to keep their pool in the best working order.  Dr. T. J. W.

Daniel and Brian provided exceptional service and went above and beyond to repair my pool pump control panel. They were both super friendly and took the time to explain how to use the new Hayward firmware installed. I highly recommend Aquamaid and both Daniel & Brian 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻

Aquamaid Pool Service has been taking care of my pool for several years now.  They are always dependable, keep my water sparkling clean and inviting.  I can’t say enough good things about this company.   “Family” is the word that comes to mind🙂.  Thank you for your service. 💕 …

I had to fire my last pool company who never provided solid advice on how to get my pool back to clean, clear and usable. What a relief to find this pool company! Within a week, my pool was back in tiptop shape and sparkling clean. Everyone was very open with their communication and walked me through the process of what needed to happen. I am so grateful to finally find a company who cares!

Charlie was a Champ. Great customer service and got the job done quickly. Charlie gave me options and suggestions for the best outcome.  My first experience with pool repair was made easy.  Thanks again Charlie I appreciate it.  Thanks Aquamaid for responding and giving me a reasonable price.

The service is prompt, professional and trustworthy. Our serviceman Charlie goes above and beyond to resolve any issue that arises—in one instance he saved us a few thousand dollars by finding a solution that our previous service people had not even considered. I highly recommend Aquamaid!

Great people and they really stay on top of my pool.  I was a bit slow  paying for a service I had done and they were very patient and always kind and understanding.  Very nice people and give me updates weekly and my pool has never been more clear!!!

Aquamaid Pool Service is our pool maintenance company. They come out weekly and provide cleaning and maintenance. We are very happy with the service, they usually send before and after pics and make sure the gates are closed.

I like the biweekly service, and appreciate my tech who arrives like clockwork on the morning of my scheduled service. I appreciate the professional maintenance to my pool, and the report I receive after every visit. Seeing the test results is a plus, and knowing that any chemicals needed are being handled for me. Great service.

First of all they provide excellent consistent maintenance service.  If we have a problem they are super responsive. For instance our pump wasn’t operating well on a Friday and the general manager came right out to help us, and returned the next day to double check. Also, Charlie installed a remote that is operated by our cell phones, and he did an excellent job. Highly recommend this company.

Just started with this company. First week was great second week tech came and left our pool completely inoperable…been calling multiple times asking for them to get someone out here to fix it before the weekend. Same tech came out and left again without the pool running. Unable to turn the pump on or anything.  Reached out to to company again asking for help and getting someone out here to look at our pool. Informed that we wouldn’t have anybody here till Monday. Which we informed her we have v

We built our pool 8 years ago and have tried a number of pool companies for various issues. Aquamaid and Charlie have been the most responsive and helpful of any pool company we used. So glad to have found them!

Daniel came out to service our pool and completed the service in no time.  While doing the service he noticed a broken part on the pump.  He asked me if I wanted him to make the repair while he was there since he had a replacement part on his truck.  Needless to say, Daniel’s attention to detail caught the problem before it became a bigger issue.
Our pool guy is great. He is in does a great job and is gone quickly. I am very happy with this company

They have been very responsive to all of my needs.  My weekly service technician, Sherry, is great.  He is very professional and alert to the needs of my pool.  I highly recommend Aquamaid Pool Service.
Jill T
Grand Prairie, TX

What a great team! The repair staff is extremely helpful and communicates very well. I will definitely call them with any pool repair needs! The office staff is also very helpful and polite every time I call the office.

Idk how good the service is, but i for sure know how awful the drivers are. Had one try to run me off the road and flip me off. Swerving in an out of traffic. Ridiculous. Should fire the guy driving that truck.

I just used this company again. They still friendly, helpful and good prices. I totally recommend them for your pool repairs.  06/15/ 2022

I finally found  a pool service  I  can  recommend  to  others. Aquamaid  employees  where  very  professional  and helpful. I  am  happiest  I  have  been  in  over  a  year  with  my  pool  thanks  to  Aquamaid.   I  will  use  them  again  wh

Zero call. Sent another email requesting owner contact me. No call. Received a text 5 days later to purchase a device for basket to help with algae. Tim performed as he always does, good service and he takes care of us as we need!

Easy to contact and very reliable!!

We had our sand filters changed on the pool,
They finished and left so we checked the pool and  noticed there was sand everywhere in the pool, also they parked in an area that was not a parking spot with both their vans and tore up the grass with big ruts where it was wet and raining. It was ridiculous.

Jarrod was extremely knowledgeable and shared that knowledge in a way that I could understand and therefore be a better pool owner!  It’ll save me money for sure!
He solved my problem that the other pool service somehow missed, so I am forever grateful.

April 15,2025

I generally give them a not to exceed a dollar amount approved, rather than wait for technician final diagnosis and repair cost. I feel I am behind the 8-ball, the pool is very important to me, but the pool is 15 years old and it is expected to have issues. Charlie did a thorough review of electrical and mechanical systems and provide provided excellent detail, including photographs

Terminating my pool service with Aquamaid. Was a customer for many years and its not till former owned pool company was acquired by Aquamaid did service level decline. Main reason for my dissatisfied occured when calling customer service to report the pool tech left my pool skimmers full of leaves. And wanted to have tech come back out to complete cleaning service. Response was to send pictures first (proof) with still no offer to complete the job.

Aquamade and my tech Joseph have been an integral part of our home maintenance.  I am.always pleased with their service and consistent communication.  I never have to wait for estimates or diagnosis on parts and or maintenance. I will recommend them for all your pool needs.
I decided to try them and am very pleased with there service, not only are they very professional but also the lowest price among other companies I searched for.

Upon his arrival he could not get the old wire to pull through the conduit. He said I needed someone with experience to get it unstuck. So I probably spent 90 minutes or more calling around to try and find a pool company to help me out. I got denial after denial because they won't install equipment bought by a customer. Update:

After posting the 1 star review, I finally got the attention of the service manager. He and I were able to come to an equitable resolution. While he had only take over a few months prior to the review - he wasn't responsible for the 1st 9 mo - he still brushed aside my concerns until I left the review. That's why I'm knocking  a star off. I do think he's trying to do better and clean up things  tho.

Danny is always very polite and knowledgeable. He has taken care of us for only two years but I am glad I found him. If you need a great pool guy then ask for Danny.

Tech was on time and diagnosed my pump problem. He did a through job and explained my pumps problems, fixed them and the pool is running really sweet. As usual great job by Aquamaid because of your associates from the front office to the techs. Oh and I can't leave out my favorite, Chet who does out weekly service, we just love Chet.

Aquamaid has been serving our pool for a few years now... the pool techs are always courteous and share information when asked. That for is us important, to make sure we are doing the right thing for the pool. Much appreciated!

Always a pleasure to deal with and very responsive.  After Thanksgiving, we had a massive amount of debris on the bottom of the pool and when our Tech Grant arrived, I gave him a heads up and he did an outstanding job of cleaning it up.  He's always been a pleasure to interact with and we're very happy with his service along with everyone else at Aquamaid.

Hired them to do a full pool drain and clean. Within 4 days of first contacting them, the entire job was done. Incredibly pleased with the professionalism and efficiency of their workers. Will be my go-to pool service company moving forward.
I would never recommend this pool company. The Pool Lady was great aquamaid is not.

I would just like to drop a note to share that had an excellent experience with Charles from Aquamaid who came out to perform a repair on a leaking pool pipe, as well as replace a check valve. He was exemplary in his professionalism, thoroughness, and follow up to ensure that the work was performed as expected, and no further leaks were present. We just transition Pool maintenance and we now have Mr. Jimmy. He is doing an amazing job!! Punctual, professional, courteous, and very detailed!! Thank you!!
Excellent experience from the first call to completion of the repair. Prompt, courteous and professional. We will absolutely use Aquamaid again.

Auqua
Aid Pool Service has been taking care of my pool and equipment for many years.  The water is always sparking clean and inviting, year round.  My equipment runs well and any suggested repairs/improvements are always appreciated.  Thank you Auquamaid.  Sincerely, Cathy Jones

Joseph is one of the most thorough techs at Aquamaid. My pool looks great when he leaves and he makes sure I am a satisfied customer by answering my many questions. I am a very happy customer of Aquamaid and will happily stay a customer with Joseph working on my pool every week.
They have been informative, took time to explain what the were doing and answered any questions that I had to resolve issues with the pool.

For the first go with Aquamaid, we were pleasantly impressed. A lot of great detail went into the cleaning and a detailed email following service. We had Aquamaid merge with our previous pool servicing so again, a great start for continued service on our pool.
Team is great with well skilled members to alert and provide feedback with solutions .

Said he’d have to check back at his office find out if they could do the work. Never heard from him again. So six months later I pay $150 for a service call. No work performed. Adam is very knowledgeable, professional and timely responsive when needed.thank you Adam

The pool service company we used for over 13 years unfortunately sold out to Aquamaid.
Within weeks of them servicing my pool I developed a scum line going all around my pool and noticed they weren’t moving my pool loungers to brush under them causing algae. Worst service ever!

Great service our pool
Tech does a fantastic job !!!
Charlie did a great job with a full pool clean! Thanks.

I just want to put out there that I am very happy, pleased and really appreciate this Aquamaid Pool Services.  They are so on top of it.  They service my pool every week, send me pictures and updates on all what they did or may need to do.  I’ve been with them for year now and I am so thankful for their professionalism and customer service.
I’ll be honest it’s hard to find companies that do what they say.    Thank you again aquamaid!!!!!!!
